question: 统计 2026 年第二季度各大区人民币收入及其占比，并按收入降序排列
expected_sql: WITH region_revenue AS (SELECT c.region, SUM(o.net_amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS revenue_cny FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c.region) SELECT region, revenue_cny, revenue_cny / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_cny) OVER (), 0) AS revenue_share FROM region_revenue ORDER BY revenue_cny DESC
description: CTE+窗口函数+收入占比+排序
